en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Sayyari, from Ali Bin Abdullah who said,
‘A man asked about the Words of the Exalted
[20:123] then whoever follows My Guidance, he shall not go astray nor be distressed
. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who acknowledges the Imams<sup>asws</sup> and follows their<sup>asws</sup> orders and do not exceed their<sup>asws</sup> obedience’.
en.sarwar: 10. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Sayyariy from Ali ibn ‘Abdallah who has said the following “
A man asked the Imam (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High.. “,
. . those who follow it (My guidance) will not go astray nor will they endure any misery.” [20:123]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “It refers to those who acknowledge the Imams (Leaders with Divine Authority) follow their commands and would not go beyond their obedience.”
